contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid:String,barcode:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          user:User = User.allInstances()->any(candidate:User | candidate.UserID = uid), copy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(candidate:BookCopy | candidate.Barcode = barcode), student:Student = Student.allInstances()->any(candidate:Student | candidate.UserID = uid), facultyUser:Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(candidate:Faculty | candidate.UserID = uid), matchingReservation:Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(candidate:Reserve | candidate.ReservedUser = user and candidate.ReservedCopy = copy and candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)
            
            precondition:
          User.allInstances()->exists(candidate:User | candidate.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(candidate:BookCopy | candidate.Barcode = barcode) and user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and user.SuspensionDays = 0 and (if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) then if student.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR then user.LoanedNumber < 20 else if student.Programme = Programme::MASTER then user.LoanedNumber < 40 else user.LoanedNumber < 60 endif endif else if user.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) then user.LoanedNumber < 60 else false endif endif) and (copy.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or (copy.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and copy.IsReserved = true and Reserve.allInstances()->exists(candidate:Reserve | candidate.ReservedUser = user and candidate.ReservedCopy = copy and candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)))
            
            postcondition:
          let loan:Loan in loan.oclIsNew() and Loan.allInstances()->includes(loan) and loan.LoanedUser = user and loan.LoanedCopy = copy and user.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and copy.LoanedRecord->includes(loan) and loan.LoanDate = Today and loan.IsReturned = false and loan.DueDate = if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) then Today.After(30) else Today.After(60) endif and user.LoanedNumber = user.LoanedNumber@pre + 1 and copy.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and loan.OverDue3Days = false and loan.OverDue10Days = false and loan.OverDue17Days = false and loan.OverDue31Days = false and (if copy.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF then copy.IsReserved = false and matchingReservation.IsReserveClosed = true else copy.IsReserved = copy.IsReserved@pre endif) and result = true
            
        }

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid:String,barcode:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          user:User = User.allInstances()->any(candidate:User | candidate.UserID = uid), copy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(candidate:BookCopy | candidate.Barcode = barcode), loan:Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(candidate:Loan | candidate.LoanedUser = user and candidate.LoanedCopy = copy and candidate.IsReturned = false), student:Student = Student.allInstances()->any(candidate:Student | candidate.UserID = uid), facultyUser:Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(candidate:Faculty | candidate.UserID = uid)
            
            precondition:
          User.allInstances()->includes(user) and BookCopy.allInstances()->includes(copy) and Loan.allInstances()->includes(loan) and user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and copy.IsReserved = false and loan.DueDate.isAfter(Today) and loan.OverDueFee = 0.0 and ((user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) and loan.RenewedTimes < 3) or (user.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) and loan.RenewedTimes < 6))
            
            postcondition:
          loan.RenewedTimes = loan.RenewedTimes@pre + 1 and loan.RenewDate = Today and loan.DueDate = if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) then if student.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR then loan.DueDate@pre.After(20) else if student.Programme = Programme::MASTER then loan.DueDate@pre.After(40) else loan.DueDate@pre.After(60) endif endif else loan.DueDate@pre.After(60) endif and result = true
            
        }
